verdict.rationale: The evidence shows the Graph API underlying Teams is OAuth-gated (401 without a token) and Microsoft Graph has a machine-readable schema, but nothing in the pack documents a mechanism for issuing scoped/least-privilege credentials specifically for an agent (e.g., app registration with granular permission consent, agent-specific scopes). Axis is applicable to an enterprise platform with Graph API and app registrations, but no evidence demonstrates the capability.
